item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-07-27
item.description: 70+ local open source policies mark China's shift to 'value realization' phase; Zhejiang's 7-department open source system plan; Embodied AI's open source moment with 3M+ OpenLET dataset downloads; OpenAtom prepares AI Agent working group.

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-07-24
item.description: MIIT quantifies China's open source ecosystem for the first time: 1.35B OpenHarmony devices, 10B model downloads; Jensen Huang defends Chinese open-source AI; White House specifically accuses Moonshot AI of distilling Fable 5; Arcee says Chinese models not inherently dangerous.

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-07-23
item.description: China launches WAICO, a 29-nation AI governance bloc backing open-source AI; Mulan License Family donated to OpenAtom Foundation; China's anthropomorphic AI rules take effect; Beijing weighs export controls on its own AI models.

item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-07-21
item.description: NDRC eight-point AI Action Plan, Trump admin considers ban on Chinese open-source models, Mulan copyleft license submitted to OSI, and Qiushi essay on AI ideology
